archetype: Archetype 2: Performance Pro (Customized for Corporate Security)

typography.notes: Outfit for strong, clean, modern headings. Inter for highly legible body copy and data entry. Follow tracking-tight for large headings.

motion_guidelines.hover_state: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and enhanced border glow or shadow.
motion_guidelines.entrance: Fade up with framer-motion (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1) staggered for grid items.
motion_guidelines.interactive: Buttons scale down slightly on tap (scale: 0.98).

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF6B35] text-white hover:bg-[#E55A2A] font-semibold rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-[#0F4C81] text-white hover:bg-[#0D3F6A] font-semibold rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition-colors

components.cards: bg-[#242424] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-8 hover:border-[#0F4C81]/50 transition-colors
components.forms: Use Shadcn Input/Select with dark mode overrides (bg-[#1A1A1A] border-white/20 text-white placeholder:text-white/40). Focus state MUST have ring-[#FF6B35].

sections.name: Navigation
sections.guidelines: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#1A1A1A]/80). Links: Home, Services & Pricing, Survey Guide, Portfolio, Contact Us. No login/register buttons.

sections.name: Hero Section
sections.guidelines: High impact. Left text, right image (or subtle background blend). Title: 'Solusi Keamanan CCTV Profesional untuk Rumah, Ruko & Korporat'. Subtitle regarding neat installation and local free transport. Two CTAs side-by-side using the primary/secondary button styles.

sections.name: The Twin Pillars (Services)
sections.guidelines: Two large bento-style cards. 1. Paket Terima Beres (Full Package). 2. Jasa Pasang Saja (Installation Only). Use distinct icons (e.g., Package/Box for full, Wrench for install). Dark card backgrounds with subtle #0F4C81 glowing border on hover.

sections.name: Quality & Craftsmanship (Before/After)
sections.guidelines: Split visual section. Left: Messy wiring / Vendor Asal Pasang (Use messy network wires image). Right: Neat conduit installation / Micro Multimedia Standard (Use clean server room image). Apply a red tint overlay to messy, blue/green to clean.

sections.name: Distance & Logistics
sections.guidelines: Information section mapping out local (Free Transport) vs long-distance (Min 8 cameras, Rp250k/point, flat regional fee). Use map/location icons.

sections.name: Survey Method
sections.guidelines: Two options grid. Option A: Virtual Survey (WhatsApp, Free). Option B: On-Site Survey (Rp500k deposit, refunded on deal). Clear, transparent trust-building layout.

sections.name: Digital Survey Leads Form
sections.guidelines: Lead generation form. Inputs: Name, Location, Camera Count, Building Type (Dropdown), Ceiling Condition (Dropdown). Submit CTA: 'Dapatkan Estimasi Biaya via WhatsApp' in Accent Orange. Include data-testid attributes.

sections.name: Portfolio Grid
sections.guidelines: Masonry or 3-column grid showing Residential, Retail/Ruko, and Corporate/Warehouse projects using provided images.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme palette (#1A1A1A base, #0F4C81 primary, #FF6B35 CTA).
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and major links have 'data-testid' attributes.
Form submit should simulate redirecting to WhatsApp. Phone number is 6282136019744.
Use framer-motion for scroll-triggered entrance animations.
